lead.headline: Jefferson misses a second practice; Swift's knee puts Monangai in play
lead.deck: ESPN still says 18.7 for Jefferson after two DNPs. Addison is the cover. New Thursday: Swift sat out, and Monangai's 8.4 hasn't moved.
lead.body: Justin Jefferson did not practise again Thursday on the sprained right ankle, his second straight absence, and ESPN still projects him at 18.7. Kevin O'Connell would say only that he is 'feeling a little bit better as the week progresses'. The plan is unchanged and likelier to be needed: if Jefferson is inactive at 12:35 Sunday, Jordan Addison takes his slot. Jalen Coker was upgraded to limited, but his own inactive call comes after Addison has locked. The afternoon's new item is in Chicago, where D'Andre Swift was added to the report with a knee and sat out. Kyle Monangai, a steady ten carries a week behind him, is still projected at 8.4. If Swift is ruled out, compare Monangai's new number with Bhayshul Tuten's before 11:00 Sunday, and take the projection. Jaylen Warren opens the week tonight at Cleveland with Rico Dowdle out; inactives were not published when this went to press.
